scenes.bubble: Year ends 31 December. When is the return due?
scenes.caption: UAE corporate tax.
scenes.say: A thirty-first of December year-end. So when is the corporate tax return due?
cap: So when is the *corporate tax return* due?

scenes.head: Nine months after year‑end
scenes.src: Federal Decree‑Law No. 47 of 2022, Arts. 48 and 53; FTA press release, 26 Sep 2026; checked 29 Oct 2026. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Generally within nine months of the end of the tax period, unless the F.T.A. sets another date. For a thirty-first of December twenty twenty-six year-end, that points to the thirtieth of September twenty twenty-seven.
cap: Generally within *nine months* of the tax period end, unless the FTA sets another date.
For a 31 December 2026 year‑end, that points to *30 September 2027*.

scenes.say: Filing and payment share that deadline, so plan the year-end close with it in mind.
cap: Filing and payment share that deadline, so plan the *year‑end close* with it in mind.
